summary: Frontend-only verification of EG metered-AI overhaul (Parts A/B/C). All three deliverables PASS on the web preview at https://modal-responsive-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) Sessions section on /tools/emotional-gatekeeper renders BOTH chip rows with the exact testIDs the request specified — eg-filter-status-{all,in_progress,completed} and eg-filter-type-{all,trap,loop,limitation,outlet,aim} — and tapping them fires the correct backend call (verified via network capture: GET /api/emotional-gatekeeper/sessions?limit=50&status=completed&session_type=trap), with the active chip switching to amber. Empty-state copy 'No sessions match these filters.' shows for combinations with zero hits. Completed sessions display the green checkmark next to the chevron. (2) The metered Trap AI flow works end-to-end and is charged per-call: a fresh Trap session created via curl through capture→landscaping→linking→looping then POST /trap/{id}/analyze returned a structured analysis in ~5s and debited 7.19 credits (1 call); a follow-up POST /sessions/{id}/report debited an additional 18.50 credits and marked the session completed. The Root-Super-Admin wallet went 946.23 → 939.04 → 920.54 credits across the two charges. (3) The per-session AI-cost chip with testID 'session-ai-cost' renders on /tools/eg-session?sessionId=… with the exact text 'AI used this session: 25.69 credits • 2 calls', styled as a purple sparkles row above the intensity block, and the Breakthrough report renders below (Breakthrough Score 8/10, all sections). (4) The error-prompt UX is correctly wired: eg-trap.tsx:111 and eg-session.tsx:48 both delegate AI failures to handleAiError() in src/utils/aiErrors.ts, which maps detail.code='insufficient_credits' → Alert with 'Charge Wallet' → router.push('/ai-wallet'), and detail.code='ai_unavailable' → Alert offering 'Use OpenAI (share data)' (PUT /ai-wallet/provider-consent + retry) or 'Top up'. The 402/503-mapping branch was not live-triggered (would require draining the test wallet) but the code path is correct and complete. Minor RN console warnings observed (non-blocking): "shadow*" style props deprecated; Image.style.resizeMode deprecated. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

issues: Filter chips (TouchableOpacity, ~28-30 px tall: paddingVertical:6 + ~12px font + ~4px line-height) fall slightly below the 44-pt iOS touch-target guideline. Still tappable in tests but could be bumped to paddingVertical:10 for accessibility.

react_native_issues.issue: RN web warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: console warning emitted repeatedly during app load.
RN web warning 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — non-blocking. Reference: console warning during /auth/login load.

action_items: Optional: bump filter-chip vertical padding from 6 → 10 to hit the 44-pt touch target on small phones.
Optional: migrate `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `style.resizeMode` → `props.resizeMode` to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required for this review — Parts A/B/C all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: aiErrors.ts handler is clean, single source of truth for metered-AI prompts; reused by eg-trap.tsx and eg-session.tsx correctly.
emotional-gatekeeper.tsx uses an IIFE inside JSX to render filtered list — works fine but could be extracted into a small render helper if other screens need to reuse the filter widget.
Filter request only fires when at least one filter is non-'all' (fetchFiltered short-circuits) — good UX, avoids redundant calls.
